title: Enhancing Food Safety Measures Following Recent Gastroenteritis Cases at Primary Schools and Incentives for Operators of School Canteens
what_it_is: Enhancing Food Safety Measures Following Recent Gastroenteritis Cases at Primary Schools and Incentives for Operators of School Canteens

sections.label: Questions on school gastroenteritis cases
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Education about gastroenteritis cases at River Valley and North View Primary Schools, food safety checks, central kitchens, HACCP standards and audit results.

sentences.speaker: Mr Fadli Fawzi
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) whether the 60 gastroenteritis cases at River Valley Primary School are linked to the food provided under the new Central Kitchen Meal Model; (b) what steps will be taken to strengthen food safety at the school; and (c) whether any punitive actions will be taken against the caterer, and if not, why not.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education in light of recent gastroenteritis incidents at River Valley and North View Primary Schools (a) what checks are in place (i) at school level and (ii) at Ministry level to ensure food safety; and (b) whether the Ministry has examined evidence on the quality and safety of food prepared in central kitchens versus onsite preparation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kenneth Tiong Boon Kiat
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Education (a) how many days after adopting the Central Kitchen Meal Model did the River Valley Primary School gastroenteritis outbreak occur; (b) whether central kitchen operators must meet Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points (HACCP) standards and the three-zone hygiene system as required in Japan; and (c) whether the Ministry will publish food safety audit results for all such operators.

sections.label: Schools using stallholder approach
sections.summary: 95% of schools continue with this trusted approach, and stallholders provide affordable and healthy meals to students.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: Today, 95% of our schools continue with this trusted approach, and stallholders have been doing an excellent job providing affordable and healthy meals to our students.

sections.label: Stallholder rentals and waivers
sections.summary: Stallholders pay rentals of five to 15 dollars per month, waived during school holidays when there are no customers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: Stallholders pay very low rentals of between five and 15 dollars per month, and we waive these during school holidays when there are no customers.

sections.label: Central Kitchen Meal Model scope
sections.summary: The Central Kitchen Meal Model will be explored only with schools with such difficulties, with no intention to scale to all schools or a target.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We will explore the Central Kitchen Meal Model only with schools with such difficulties.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: We have no intention to scale this to all schools, nor do we have a target in mind.

sections.label: MOE food safety collaboration
sections.summary: MOE will continue working with SFA, the Communicable Diseases Agency and operators to strengthen food safety management systems.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: MOE will continue to work with SFA, the Communicable Diseases Agency (CDA) and the operators to strengthen food safety management systems.

sections.label: Average school gastroenteritis incidents
sections.summary: Gastroenteritis incidents in schools averaged six cases a year in the past three years across all food service models.

sentences.text: The number of gastroenteritis incidents in schools have averaged six cases a year in the past three years across all food service models.

sections.label: Food safety enforcement action
sections.summary: SFA takes immediate enforcement action and requires rectifications where food safety breaches are detected, at central kitchens or stalls.

sentences.text: Where food safety breaches are detected, whether at central kitchens or individual stalls, SFA takes immediate enforcement action and requires rectifications.

sections.label: Alternative kitchens and operator limits
sections.summary: These include activating alternative central kitchens while implementing more permanent solutions, and limiting each operator to four or five schools.

sentences.text: These include activation of alternative central kitchens, while implementing more permanent solutions.
We have also taken a cautious approach by limiting each operator to just serving just four or five schools.

sections.label: Central Kitchen Meal Model options
sections.summary: Central Kitchen Meal Model operators currently have between six and 14 options a day, and the menu changes weekly.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: Our Central Kitchen Meal Model operators currently have between six and 14 options a day, and the menu does change on a weekly basis.

sections.label: Investigation still underway
sections.summary: The investigation is still underway, so the Central Kitchen Meal Model should not be assumed to be the reason for the gastroenteritis cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: First, I need to reiterate that the investigation is still underway.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: So, we should not assume that the Central Kitchen Meal Model was the reason for the gastroenteritis cases.

sections.label: Wait for River Valley investigation
sections.summary: The Member should wait for the investigation results before talking more about the River Valley Primary case.

sentences.speaker: Ms Jasmin Lau
sentences.text: On the second question, I would suggest that the Member wait for the investigation results before talking more about the River Valley Primary case.
